# `armada replica`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armada.md)

A replica is one running copy of an app, with its containers, on one node.
`armada replica list` names them the way --replica takes them.

Also: `replicas`.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`armada replica list`](#armada-replica-list) | List an app's replicas, or every app's |

## `armada replica list`

List replicas with their short name, node, state, revision, and
containers. The short name is what `--replica` takes in `armada app exec`
and `armada app logs`, and the containers what `--container` takes.

```
armada replica list [APP] [flags]
```

Also: `ls`.

Examples:

```bash
armada replica list api
armada app exec api --replica k3p9x --container log-ship
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |
